statusDefinitions.implemented: Code adapter or capability exists; this does not imply runtime configuration or connectivity.
statusDefinitions.configured: Required runtime configuration is believed present; end-to-end success is not proven.
statusDefinitions.live_verified: A dated live probe proved the specified capability and response contract.
statusDefinitions.blocked: A concrete failure prevents the capability from being accepted.
statusDefinitions.not_implemented: No implementation has been verified in this repository.
statusDefinitions.not_tested: No sufficient evidence is available; do not infer success.

integrations.name: REDULTRON Central Agent / Cloudflare Worker
integrations.auth: Owner-secret authenticated internal routes; never expose credentials to the PWA.
integrations.safetyGate: Production writes/deployments must require explicit workflow dispatch approval and protected production environment.
integrations.timeoutRetry: Bounded per-route timeouts; inspect route-specific implementation before changing.

lastEvidence.result: Worker health gate passed in strict certification; authenticated Python hybrid execution failed via HTTP 502 HYBRID_CORE_AUTH_REJECTED.

integrations.failureMode: Fail closed for authenticated execution; do not report Python execution verified when upstream auth fails.
integrations.disablePath: Use protected deployment controls; do not change production secrets from this registry.

integrations.name: Render Python Hybrid Core
integrations.auth: Worker sends x-owner-secret; Python Core validates X-Owner-Secret and requires at least 32 characters.
integrations.safetyGate: No auth bypass. Compare credential parity through an authorized read-only method; never print values.
integrations.timeoutRetry: Strict authenticated probe is bounded by the certification workflow; do not retry indefinitely.

lastEvidence.result: Python health passed; authenticated round-trip failed with HTTP 502 and sanitized code HYBRID_CORE_AUTH_REJECTED. Exact cause is not established.

integrations.failureMode: Return non-success; fallback must be explicit and hybridPythonCoreExecutionVerified must remain false.
integrations.disablePath: Disable hybrid execution via reviewed configuration/code; preserve health endpoint for diagnosis.

integrations.safetyGate: PR #431 proposes manual-only production mutations with explicit approval and the production Environment; it remains open/draft and is not active on main.

integrations.name: Live Search providers and fallback
integrations.auth: Provider-specific API key where required; no provider secret in client-side code.
integrations.safetyGate: Return source URLs and provider attribution; distinguish fresh results from stale-cache results.
integrations.timeoutRetry: Bound provider timeout; bounded stale cache; no unbounded retry loops.
integrations.dataClass: public query text and fetched public results

lastEvidence.result: Latest reported health metadata showed Tavily disabled and provider reachability not checked; fresh provider round-trip is not verified.

integrations.failureMode: Expose provider failure or stale status explicitly; never label cached output as live.
integrations.disablePath: Disable provider adapter through reviewed server-side configuration.
